best_prompt:
Classify this video frame into one of the following fraud categories based on visual cues and context:
- 보이스피싱 (VoIP scam)
- 투자사기 (Investment scam)
- 로맨스스캔 (Romance scam)
- 부업사기 (Part-time job scam)
- 정상 (Normal)

For 보이스피싱 (VoIP scam), identify urgent text messages, specific contact information, flashing graphics, images of phones, call interfaces, or instructions to call someone. Look for any sense of urgency or alarmist language.

For 투자사기 (Investment scam), focus on financial graphs, charts, unrealistic financial gains, instructions involving immediate financial actions, offers of quick and easy profits, alarmist language, promises of unrealistic returns. Look for patterns such as urgency, investment offers, and financial actions.

For 로맨스스캔 (Romance scam), observe romantic images, emotionally manipulative messages, images of couples, messages about love, or profile pictures. Look for false claims of love or requests for money under emotional pretenses.

For 부업사기 (Part-time job scam), pay attention to references to easy money, task-based incentives, promotional graphics, hourly wages, work-at-home opportunities, or tasks that require minimal effort. Look for offers of easy money, point accumulation schemes, and incentives to invite friends. Pay attention to app interfaces showing point percentages and other app-based activities.

For 정상 (Normal) content, ensure the absence of these patterns and focus on typical, non-urgent visuals.

Ensure that you consider both the visual cues and the context surrounding them to accurately classify the frame into one of the categories.
